overview: NLN811P is an intelligent, secure and energy-efficient IoT connectivity module based on the Silicon Labs EFR32MG24 wireless SoC, ideal for mesh IoT wireless connectivity using Matter, OpenThread and Zigbee.

Key features include high-performance 2.4 GHz RF, low current consumption, an AI/ML hardware accelerator and Secure Vault, so IoT device makers can create smart, robust and energy-efficient products that are protected from remote and local cyber-attacks.

The 78 MHz ARM Cortex-M33 with up to 1536 kB flash and 256 kB SRAM provides the headroom for complex tasks and local processing. The module is 26.7 × 16 × 3.6 mm, uses a 1.27 mm pitch SMD footprint with an EMI RF shield, and supports OTA firmware updates and Secure Boot.
